trackers.title: Connected trackers
trackers.description: Work that lives in Linear or Jira, on the board here. Statuses travel both ways, so an agent can be handed any of it.
trackers.emptyDescription: Connect Linear or Jira and their issues appear as tasks here, keeping their reference. Move one on this board and it moves there too.
trackers.disconnectDescription: The tasks it brought in stay where they are and stop being kept in step. Nothing is deleted in the tracker.
trackers.linearQuery: Team key, such as ENG. Leave it empty for every issue the key can see.
trackers.jiraQuery: JQL. Leave it empty for everything, newest first.
trackers.pushHint: Moving a task here moves the issue there. Off by default: writing into somebody else's tracker is a decision, not a side effect of connecting one.
